Open Alabama on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 19, 2026. This deadline has passed. Check your registration status with the Alabama Secretary of State.
  • Last day to apply for an absentee ballot by mail: October 27, 2026. Alabama does not have no-excuse early voting. To vote absentee, you must give an allowed reason. Your mailed absentee application must arrive by this date.
  • Last day to apply for an absentee ballot in person: October 29, 2026. Apply in person at your county's absentee election manager.
  • Last day to hand-deliver an absentee ballot: November 2, 2026. Absentee ballots returned by mail must be received by noon on Election Day, November 3.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.

Official election information: Alabama Secretary of State – Alabama Votes

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.
